notes: Synthetic. platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors#request-size-limits: "On the first-party Claude API, Cloudflare returns this error before the request reaches the API servers." This is Cloudflare's own 413 page, the body a client gets when Cloudflare answers instead of the API (the page does not show the body; error_request_too_large has the documented JSON form). Not recordable: it needs a body over 128 MB.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap X6: an error body parseAnthropicError cannot decode (HTML or text from Cloudflare or a proxy) becomes ErrUpstreamProvider, which is always 502, whatever the upstream status: a 4xx turns into a retryable upstream failure that is retried, failed over and counted against the circuit breaker
